title: Expect
description: A --test scenario's expect.yaml, after YAML parsing: what the run must do (docs/design/skill-tests.md, SPEC §7.3). Every field is optional, but at least one of outcome, exit, path or path_prefix must be set, and path and path_prefix don't combine.

path.description: Every section entered, in order: the entry section, then the `to` of each transfer. Names match by slug.

path_prefix.description: The start of the path, as for path.

asks.description: Keyed by a section with one ask, or Section.var for the ask that binds var. `chosen` is the option's label: a section name, a list item, yes or no, or a Score level. When the ask runs more than once, the last answer counts.

page_contains.description: Text that some page's message must contain.

live.description: Used only with --live (SPEC §7.3): runs per scenario, the share of runs that must be hits (default 1), and the points by which each expected ask's lowest confidence must clear sure (without it, under 5 is a warning).
